# Official Content Pack - Version 29Â 

***

## **ADDITIONS:**

*   Updated to 1.21.1
*   Added `crashSpeedMin` & `crashSpeedMax` to vehicles
*   Added 5 new wood variants to MC172
*   Added Russian translation
*   Added Fr\*nch translation
*   Added huge wheel for future content
*   Re-added the url thing on the side of the GMC box bed
*   Added festive bell206
*   Added Muddac to large, medium & small wheels
*   Added blinker sound to the outside of cars
*   Added Frost Accumulation to some cars
*   Added Odometer function to the RPM car gauge
*   Added interactive cockpit to Eclipse 500
*   finally added cinderblocks to the GMC Brig
*   finally added cinderblocks to the firetruck
*   Added slots for custom steering wheel to cars
*   Added slots for custom dash / bobblehead ornaments to cars
*   Added speed based impact damage to aircraft
*   Added Auxiliary battery slots to cars and aircraft
*   Added totaled explosion sounds to ground vehicles
*   Added camera roll to ground vehicles, AKA Camera tilts based on your driving
*   Added police liveries to Mustang & Mercedes
*   Added new random particle lifetime variation to many ocp particles
*   Added woking police sirens to police cars (finally)
*   Added police siren to mustang too gooogoo gaga

## **CHANGES:**

*   All ground vehicles now have their correct engine preinstalled, and the corresponding engine is part of the initial recipe
*   Removed engine hours from car tachometer gauge
*   adapted new isOpenTop functions & retired old soundPass systems
*   add new soundPass system, cutting 30% of unnecessary sound code
*   tweaked doors, hoods, flaps, windows etc. to dissapear on totaled vehicles
*   completly overhauled Ford Mustang Engine sounds
*   added chained wheels (not yet fictional)
*   added a few new large wheel variants
*   tweaked interior sounds to have proper ranges due to new soundPass system
*   Optimized burnt / totaled textures, massively reducing pack disc size, cutting up to 20MB
*   Tweaked things
*   Changed normal wheels grip settings
*   Overhauled damage smoke visuals for ground vehicles
*   offset rear GMC block hitbox to reduce frequent terrain collisions
*   tweaked GMC minimum crash damage tolerance
*   Tweaked Mustang recipe
*   Increased GMC Brigadier health
*   Headlights now use a lit texture instead of pure white color when on
*   changed salesign formatting from 0000$ to $0000
*   Added seats by default to AA cannons
*   Increased Propeller health
*   Reduced frosting speeed

## **FIXES:**

*   fixed scout playing inside sounds when no roof is present
*   fixed FT and firetruck not having totaled fire particles
*   fixed both exhaust particles for PZL being bound to one single engine
*   fix RH HR RHHRHRHR HRHRH RH R HRH RH RH wheel screeching cars make when standing still
*   fixed quad model having an empty object
*   fixed brigadier having skill issue with one block height increments
*   fixed wierd red strobe light offset on Comanche
*   fixed not being able to attach grille ornament to mustang
*   fixed fire extinguisher being slightly offset
*   fixed minor texture errors
*   fixed faulty engine power clamp on mustang, making it impossible to mount the correct engnie
*   fixed strobe lights strobing when a vehicle is totaled
*   fixed doorwinnd playing isnide skyhawk during flight
*   Fixed Mustang not accepting its own engine
*   Fixed GMC and FIretruck not having cinder blocks when wheels are missing
*   Fixed Bell206 freezing randomly when no enigne is installed
*   Fixed Mustang freezing without enignein
*   Fixed doorwind playing inside when doors are closed
*   Fixed watertrail particles being spammed
*   Fixed GMC colliding with blocks and getting destroyed quickly
*   Fixed snail sculpture java model
*   Fixed static merc raindrop particles
